## WhatsApp Lead Receptionist — Local Services (Enhanced Sample)

**Flow:** WhatsApp webhook intake -> normalize payload -> score & route -> log every lead -> instant owner alert on Hot -> window-aware auto-reply.

**Setup:** 1) In Meta app, point the WhatsApp webhook to this workflow's URL. 2) Pick your Google Sheet in both Sheets nodes (Leads tab + Errors tab). 3) Set the owner email in the Gmail node. 4) Replace phoneNumberId in both WhatsApp nodes and create/approve the re-engagement template. 5) Edit CONFIG in node 3: vertical pack, business hours, booking link.

**Credits:** Structural patterns (WhatsApp trigger intake, 24h-window template branch) adapted from Zie619/n8n-workflows (MIT, (c) 2025 Zie619) — see LICENSE-BASE-MIT.txt. Scoring/routing/normalization code is original work.

_notes: Enhanced sample built 2026-10-23. Base patterns adapted from Zie619/n8n-workflows (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2025 Zie619): WhatsApp trigger intake shape and the 24h-window/template-reopen branch idea (files workflows/Whatsapp/1521_*.json, 2030_*.json). Everything else - payload normalization, vertical lead scoring, business-hours routing, dead-letter error handling, reply drafting - is original code. On import: connect Google Sheets (Leads + Errors tabs) and Gmail credentials, set owner email, replace phoneNumberId in both WhatsApp nodes, create the 'lead_followup' template in Meta, and edit CONFIG in node 3 (vertical / hours / booking link). Sheets/Gmail/WhatsApp nodes are structurally validated only; the two Code nodes are unit-tested locally (see test/run_tests.js).
